author: YOSHUHORU
quote:
The graphics are impressive but the framerate was sacrificed needlessly. 

I'm not a fan of the story. The characters are bland. I don't like being in a relationship with Lucia.

I get the impression they made the performance rubbish to aim for the PS6 or upcoming Xbox consoles so we'd end up buying the "remastered" 60fps version, which makes this release feel like a massive cash grab.

author: YOSHUHORU
quote:
Beautiful graphics, smooth gameplay, addictive as a bar of chocolate!

Sometimes I like to stop playing and just look at the world.

I'm not nostalgic for the original as I never played it. I genuinely find this game so charming and fun.

Even better is the physical version having the entire game on the cartridge, with the exclusion of a tiny day one patch. It plays straight out of the box which reminds me of the days when I could pop a DS game into the slot and play instantly.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
